journey.name: Study loop — reveal and grade due cards
journey.description: Spaced-repetition session over the deck created in journey 02. New cards count as due. Requires journeys 01 and 02 to have run (signed in, "Animals PT" deck exists).

actions.action: Launch the Echo app and verify the Home screen is shown
Open the Decks tab and tap the "Animals PT" deck
Verify the deck detail screen shows a due-cards count greater than zero and a study button
Tap the study button to start a session
Verify a study card is shown with a position indicator like "1 of 3" and the card front text visible
Tap the card to reveal the answer
Verify the card back is revealed and four grade buttons are shown (Again, Hard, Good, Easy)
Verify the session advanced to the next card ("2 of 3")
Reveal and grade the remaining cards with "Good"
Verify a session-complete state is shown (summary or return affordance)
Close the study session and verify the app returns to the previous screen
